source: ns-3 TreeAllReduce (chunk-pipelined full-volume, post volume-fix) on --topology=switched via h200-tree-allreduce.cfg
model: T = S(D) + 2*log2(N)*t_min_switch + alpha(N)*D/tree_bw; alpha = 1 (N<=2) / 2 (N<=4) / 3 (N>=5) = busiest GPU<->NVSwitch trunk load in D units
fit_set: all points, relative-error weighted (1/T^2); N in {4,8,16} x 1-256 MB
